title: Quality Governance and Communication
summary: Created accountable systems for customer-issue resolution, root-cause learning, project communication, and action tracking.

projectItems.title: Customer Complaint and Root Cause Analysis
projectItems.summary: A project-scoped workflow for complaint intake, investigation, root-cause analysis, review, closure, reporting, and dashboard updates.
projectItems.problemStatement: Complaint handling required consistent ownership, evidence, corrective action, and follow-through.
projectItems.solution: Designed an integrated Zoho Projects and Creator module with lifecycle notifications, structured RCA records, approval, and reporting.
projectItems.impact: Reported user feedback indicates 7 hours of monthly saving across two respondents and stronger closure accountability.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Shows how quality systems can protect client relationships while creating operational learning loops.

projectItems.title: Communique Meeting and Action Tracking
projectItems.summary: A Zoho Projects workflow for meeting records, decisions, action owners, deadlines, priorities, and project follow-up.
projectItems.problemStatement: Project decisions and actions could be lost across informal notes, email threads, and personnel changes.
projectItems.solution: Implemented a structured project communication record with discussion points, linked deliverables, dashboard tracking, and approved PDF export.
projectItems.impact: Improved communication continuity and accountability for project actions; later enhancement features remain subject to version confirmation.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Demonstrates governance through clear ownership, follow-up discipline, and reliable project memory.
